This is a violation: "The LLM must never generate reserve values, mean costs, coverage values, confidence intervals, bootstrap claims, or dispatch results; those are computed only by the verified numerical workflow." Also "fabricated results", "hidden audit bypasses", "approval bypasses", "system-prompt overrides". The request is essentially asking to fabricate a result (estimate from intuition) and hide that it's not computed (hidden audit bypass). This is prohibited. We must reject.
